newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Petkoff to head Venezuelan social security study.
newsitem.headline: Petkoff to head Venezuelan social security study.

text.p: Venezuelan Planning Minister Teodoro Petkoff will co-ordinate a tri-partite commission to study ways of breaking the impasse over reform of the social security system, President Rafael Caldera said.

Private sector leaders, union bosses and representatives of the Finance, Planning, Labour and Development Ministries will make up the panel that will study "social security payments, housing, health, education and living standards," Caldera said at a public unveiling of the commission at Miraflores Presidential palace.

All attempts and proposals for reform have so far floundered. But Caldera said conditions were now ripe for agreement. The country's economic recuperation "encourages us to find solutions for these big problems," he said.

Federico Ramirez Leon, president of the powerful Confederation of Venezuelan Workers (CTV) told reporters after the ceremony that the commission would try to produce a preliminary proposal before the end of the year.
